spec.source:
sequenceDiagram
 participant U as User
 participant A as Personal Agent
 participant C as Company
 U->>A: Supply credentials for this issuer
 A->>C: Credentials to mediated endpoint
 C-->>A: Optional verification challenge
 U->>A: Supply requested code
 A->>C: Complete sign-in for session_id
 C-->>A: Account and Session Tokens
